title: Tape trouble and drafted into the army
summary: Schremp mentions re-doing a lost portion of the interview; Handy was drafted around September 1942 and served months at Camp Gruber.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I found out that the last bit of this thing, I didn't have the tape running properly, I had to go over twenty, thirty minutes of the interview again which didn't make him very happy at all. He didn't understand why I was there anyway. He had a major part of the world to run that morning. We skipped over your stint in the army; how do we fit that in?
Let me see. 1941--it was December, 1941. 1942, I was drafted in about September. I was in about-- did we ever discover how long I was in the army, Babe?
It wasn't even a full year. I spent my time in the army down
in Oklahoma, in Muskogee with the Rainbow Division and that's where I left the army from Camp what?
Those are the only two Oklahoma camps I remember.
No, this is--Camp Gruber, in Muskogee, Oklahoma.
